Package edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.render

Class GraticuleRenderer

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.render.GraticuleRenderer
public final class GraticuleRenderer extends Object
Renders a map outline and latitude/longitude graticule lines for a given IMapProjection.

Rendering steps

  1. Optionally draws the projection's outer boundary via IMapProjection.drawMapOutline(Graphics2D, IContainer).
  2. Draws latitude parallels from -π/2 to +π/2 in steps of getLatitudeStepRad().
  3. Draws longitude meridians from -π to +π in steps of getLongitudeStepRad().

Actual drawing is fully delegated to the projection, so the graticule appearance (color, stroke, curve shape) automatically matches the projection and its MapTheme. This class is intentionally thin — it is only responsible for iterating over the lat/lon grid and dispatching to the projection.

Graticule color

The line color is determined by each projection's IMapProjection.drawLatitudeLine(java.awt.Graphics2D, edu.cnu.mdi.container.IContainer, double) and IMapProjection.drawLongitudeLine(java.awt.Graphics2D, edu.cnu.mdi.container.IContainer, double) implementations, which are required to use MapTheme.getGraticuleColor() rather than a hardcoded value. Changing the theme on the projection automatically changes the graticule color on the next repaint.

Step precision

A small epsilon (1e-9 rad) is added to the loop upper bound so that the final step (e.g. exactly +π/2 or +π) is not silently skipped due to floating-point accumulation errors.

    • render

      public void render(Graphics2D g2, IContainer container)
      Renders the map outline (if enabled) followed by all graticule lines.

      Latitude parallels are drawn for φ ∈ [-π/2, +π/2] and longitude meridians for λ ∈ [-π, +π], both using the configured step size. A small epsilon is added to the upper bound of each loop to ensure the endpoint is always included despite floating-point accumulation.

      Drawing appearance is fully controlled by the projection and its MapTheme; this method does not set any graphics state.

      Parameters:
      g2 - graphics context to draw into; must not be null
      container - container providing the world-to-local transform; must not be null
